records.source_Japanese:
旗艦がやられました！
%sに
退避します！
records.current_English: Our flagship's out of action! We're retreating to %s!
records.speaker: Original logical First Mate role1 through53D44/82478
records.context: After original flagship incapacitation,this fleet method swaps the chosen surviving ship into slot0,uses its original CShip virtual name getter as the single%s argument,and has logical First Mate role1 speak through53D44/table02117080. It then clears/reassigns duties and installs the existing captain on the replacement ship. This is a transfer to another ship,not a town or port name. No specific sinking or death is asserted by the seven Japanese lines.
records.source_meaning: A polite report that the flagship has been incapacitated and the speakers are withdrawing to the named replacement ship.
records.english: Our flagship's out of action! We're retreating to %s!
records.localization_note: Retain the fluent complete current report. Retreating to names the other vessel in this source-proven transfer context;it does not claim a town destination or that the flagship sank.
